sources.source_name: Shopify changelog: owner_type required for Checkout and Customer Account extension metafields in 2027-01
sources.purpose: Guard Checkout and Customer Account UI extension deployments against API 2027-01 owner_type missing declaration errors
sources.cost_quota: free public documentation; no store API calls
sources.reliability_limits: Only applies to Checkout and Customer Account UI extensions declaring metafields in shopify.extension.toml; repository search found no such extension on main as of 2026-10-28, so actual applicability is unverified.

learnings.title: Checkout and Customer Account UI metafield owner_type gate for Shopify API 2027-01
learnings.claim: Shopify's October 8, 2026 developer changelog says Checkout and Customer Account UI extensions using API version 2027-01 or later must specify owner_type for every metafield declaration in shopify.extension.toml, including extensions.metafields and extensions.targeting.metafields; deployments missing owner_type will be blocked. API 2026-10 supports optional owner_type. Extensions without declared metafields are unaffected.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_EXTENSION_OWNER_TYPE_2027_01_GATE: Before upgrading any Checkout or Customer Account UI extension to API 2027-01 or later, inventory shopify.extension.toml declarations and require a valid owner_type for every extensions.metafields and extensions.targeting.metafields entry. If no matching extension exists, mark N/A rather than invent a migration or changing the store. Never deploy automatically or claim applied_learning_ids without a real decision/manifest.
learnings.next_measurement: Inspect actual video_shopify checkout/customer UI extension source and API version. Current main GitHub search returned no shopify.extension.toml, extensions.metafields or owner_type; mark REVIEW_ONLY/N/A until an extension is present. If found, add a fixture-based positive/negative deploy config test and record actual manifest SHA plus applied_learning_ids.
fallback_history: If API version is 2026-10 and no planned upgrade, record optional owner_type status; if extension does not declare metafields, the new gate is not applicable.
